_comment: Scoped mutation testing (Stryker) for pure leaf modules with existing jest coverage.
Modeled on OmniRoute's approach: mutate ONLY a small set of leaves, never the whole repo.
SCOPE RATIONALE:
The root jest suite (testMatch **/test/**/*.test.js) covers exactly 3 source modules:
- scripts/validate-schemas.js   (frontmatter parsing, company/kit schema validation)
- scripts/parity-audit.js       (adapter/skills/config parity classification)
- scripts/reconcile-backlog-state.mjs (parseArgs, inferPrNumber/inferReleaseTag, reconcileBacklog)
These are the only modules where mutants can be killed by existing tests, so they are
the only honest mutation scope. locales/pt-BR/scripts/* are near-identical mirrors and
are excluded to avoid double cost; scripts/skill-leak-check.js has NO tests (every
mutant would survive by definition) and is excluded until it gains coverage.
RUNNER CHOICE: @stryker-mutator/jest-runner (tests are real jest, unlike OmniRoute's
node:test tap-runner setup). Jest 30 + ESM (--experimental-vm-modules) is handled by the
runner automatically for type:module projects; jest.config.js is reused via configFile.
CADENCE: nightly/weekly, NOT per-PR — each mutant spawns a jest run.
npm run test:mutation           # full scoped run (sets NODE_OPTIONS for ESM jest)
NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules npx stryker run --dryRunOnly    # validate baseline only
Baseline recorded in reports/mutation/mutation.json (jsonReporter).
JEST OVERRIDE: jest.config.js ignores /.stryker-tmp/ so repo-level `npm test` skips sandbox
copies. Inside the Stryker sandbox every path contains .stryker-tmp, which would exclude ALL
tests (dry run: 'No tests were found'), so the jest.config override below narrows
testPathIgnorePatterns back to /node_modules/ for mutation runs only.
_ignorePatterns_comment: ignorePatterns only controls what is NOT copied into the Stryker sandbox; scope is set by `mutate` above. Exclude heavy, mutation-irrelevant trees to keep sandbox creation fast.
